description: Welcome to cosmic verse ! I am a 4th-year Veterinary Biotechnology student and creative storyteller/designer. We are a solo project (at this moment) dedicated to blending science with powerful visual narratives for the 'Abandoned but not Forgotten' challenge. Our focus is to create high-impact, artistic visual concepts and tell the unique stories of lost tech on the Moon and Mars
summary: Cosmic Verse presents "Echoes of the Red & Grey," an educational and visual digital storytelling project. We honor NASA's historic and abandoned assets—the Apollo 11 Lunar Plaque and the Opportunity Rover—transforming their silent legacies into inspiring narratives for future generations
details:
What it does: Provides a 7-slide visual narrative highlighting the historical significance of abandoned space assets on the Moon and Mars.

How it works: Combines minimalist aesthetic design with poetic first-person voices of historic hardware, connecting past space exploration with modern science.

Tools Used: Canva for slide design, AI tools for enhancing visual concepts, and NASA official historical archives.
